name: Manto Hotel Lima - Mgallery
positioning: Manto Hotel Lima - MGallery Collection, a boutique hotel in Lima's San Isidro district, inspired by the tapadas limeñas and mixing contemporary design with historical references
best_for: Travelers wanting a calm boutique base in San Isidro, steps from parks, golf and restaurants
Guests who want help discovering Lima's cultural landmarks

facts.text: Manto Hotel Lima MGallery Collection is a boutique hotel in San Isidro, one of Lima's most elegant districts.
The hotel is inspired by the figure of the tapadas limeñas.
The hotel combines contemporary design with historical references.
Nearby landmarks include Huaca Huallamarca, El Olivar Forest and the Lima Golf Club.
The hotel is steps from parks, golf, restaurants and cultural destinations.
The hotel has a rooftop restaurant and bar.
Saya Terraza & Bistró serves creative local cuisine and signature cocktails with a San Isidro view.
Room types include Junior Suites with one king-size bed.
Deluxe rooms are available with two double beds.
The fitness centre offers personalised training.
Amenities include high-speed Wi-Fi, private parking, 24/7 reception and meeting space.
